name: my-demo
_comment: Sample flow against a placeholder app. Two things tie this file to a real app: baseUrl (the exact address you type in your browser, the same one you passed to login.js) and the selectors. Replace every selector below with real ones from your app's HTML. Prefer [data-testid='...'] if your app has them; text= and role selectors also work. The spine here is the common demo shape: open the app, create something, wait for async processing, show the result.

steps.text: A quick tour of the app.
We start by creating a new record.
The app processes it in the background.
